agent_test_comparison_status_result_chec.name: agent_test_comparison_status_result_check
agent_test_comparison_status_result_chec.value: ("agent_test_comparison"."status" = 'PENDING' and "agent_test_comparison"."completedAt" is null) or ("agent_test_comparison"."status" <> 'PENDING' and "agent_test_comparison"."completedAt" is not null)

agent_test_improvement_review_state_chec.name: agent_test_improvement_review_state_check
agent_test_improvement_review_state_chec.value: ("agent_test_improvement"."status" = 'OPEN' and "agent_test_improvement"."reviewedAt" is null) or ("agent_test_improvement"."status" <> 'OPEN' and "agent_test_improvement"."reviewedAt" is not null)

agent_test_publish_check_request_digest_.name: agent_test_publish_check_request_digest_check
agent_test_publish_check_request_digest_.value: ("agent_test_publish_check"."baselineRequestDigest" is null or (typeof("agent_test_publish_check"."baselineRequestDigest") = 'text' and length("agent_test_publish_check"."baselineRequestDigest") = 64 and "agent_test_publish_check"."baselineRequestDigest" not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*')) and ("agent_test_publish_check"."candidateRequestDigest" is null or (typeof("agent_test_publish_check"."candidateRequestDigest") = 'text' and length("agent_test_publish_check"."candidateRequestDigest") = 64 and "agent_test_publish_check"."candidateRequestDigest" not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*'))

agent_test_publish_check_result_state_ch.name: agent_test_publish_check_result_state_check
agent_test_publish_check_result_state_ch.value: ("agent_test_publish_check"."status" = 'PENDING_BASELINE' and "agent_test_publish_check"."baselineReferences" is null and "agent_test_publish_check"."candidateReferences" is null and "agent_test_publish_check"."completedAt" is null) or ("agent_test_publish_check"."status" = 'PENDING_DRAFT' and "agent_test_publish_check"."candidateReferences" is null and "agent_test_publish_check"."completedAt" is null) or ("agent_test_publish_check"."status" = 'COMPLETE' and "agent_test_publish_check"."candidateReferences" is not null and "agent_test_publish_check"."completedAt" is not null) or ("agent_test_publish_check"."status" = 'ERROR' and "agent_test_publish_check"."completedAt" is not null)

conversation_qa_evaluation_scores_check.name: conversation_qa_evaluation_scores_check
conversation_qa_evaluation_scores_check.value: ("conversation_qa_evaluation"."helpfulness" is null or "conversation_qa_evaluation"."helpfulness" between 1 and 5) and ("conversation_qa_evaluation"."grounding" is null or "conversation_qa_evaluation"."grounding" between 1 and 5)

conversation_qa_evaluation_result_check.name: conversation_qa_evaluation_result_check
conversation_qa_evaluation_result_check.value: ("conversation_qa_evaluation"."status" <> 'COMPLETED' or ("conversation_qa_evaluation"."helpfulness" is not null and "conversation_qa_evaluation"."grounding" is not null and "conversation_qa_evaluation"."sentiment" is not null and "conversation_qa_evaluation"."escalationOutcome" is not null and "conversation_qa_evaluation"."lowScore" in (0, 1) and "conversation_qa_evaluation"."lowScore" = (case when "conversation_qa_evaluation"."grounding" < 3 or "conversation_qa_evaluation"."escalationOutcome" = 'MISSED' or "conversation_qa_evaluation"."helpfulness" + "conversation_qa_evaluation"."grounding" < 6 then 1 else 0 end)))

conversation_qa_evaluation_model_check.name: conversation_qa_evaluation_model_check
conversation_qa_evaluation_model_check.value: ("conversation_qa_evaluation"."modelProvider" is null or "conversation_qa_evaluation"."modelProvider" in ('OPENAI', 'GOOGLE')) and ("conversation_qa_evaluation"."modelName" is null or length("conversation_qa_evaluation"."modelName") between 1 and 256)

conversation_qa_evaluation_usage_check.name: conversation_qa_evaluation_usage_check
conversation_qa_evaluation_usage_check.value: ("conversation_qa_evaluation"."inputTokens" is null or "conversation_qa_evaluation"."inputTokens" >= 0) and ("conversation_qa_evaluation"."outputTokens" is null or "conversation_qa_evaluation"."outputTokens" >= 0)

instructions.default: 'Answer clearly and only use information you know is reliable. If you are unsure, say so.'
